[SOURCE id=function_code:function:function-text:515064cfcdad kind=function_code issue=-1 path=function_code/4.OpENer/function.txt]
EtherNet/IP and CIP Function Code Reference
===========================================

Scope
-----
This file contains:

1. EtherNet/IP Encapsulation Commands
2. Common Packet Format Item Type IDs
3. CIP Common Service Codes
4. CIP Connection Manager Service Codes
5. CIP General Status Codes
6. Common CIP Object Class IDs
7. Response service-code rule

================================================================
1. ETHERNET/IP ENCAPSULATION COMMANDS
================================================================

0x0000 = NOP
0x0004 = ListServices
0x0063 = ListIdentity
0x0064 = ListInterfaces
0x0065 = RegisterSession
0x0066 = UnregisterSession
0x006F = SendRRData
0x0070 = SendUnitData
0x0072 = IndicateStatus
0x0073 = Cancel

Other values:
    Reserved or future encapsulation commands.

Command summary:

0x0000 NOP
    No-operation encapsulation command.

0x0004 ListServices
    Request supported encapsulation services.

0x0063 ListIdentity
    Discover EtherNet/IP device identity.

0x0064 ListInterfaces
    Request communication interfaces.

0x0065 RegisterSession
    Register an EtherNet/IP encapsulation session.

0x0066 UnregisterSession
    Unregister an active encapsulation session.

0x006F SendRRData
    Send unconnected request/response data.

0x0070 SendUnitData
    Send connected explicit or connected data.

0x0072 IndicateStatus
    Legacy encapsulation status indication.

0x0073 Cancel
    Cancel an outstanding request where supported.

================================================================
2. ENCAPSULATION HEADER FIELDS
================================================================

Command:
    2 bytes, little-endian

Length:
    2 bytes, little-endian

Session Handle:
    4 bytes, little-endian

Status:
    4 bytes, little-endian
[/SOURCE]

0x01 Get_Attributes_All
    Read all attributes supported by this service.

0x02 Set_Attributes_All
    Write all attributes supported by this service.

0x03 Get_Attribute_List
    Read selected attributes.

0x04 Set_Attribute_List
    Write selected attributes.

0x05 Reset
    Reset the target object or device.

0x06 Start
    Start object operation.

0x07 Stop
    Stop object operation.

0x08 Create
    Create an object instance.

0x09 Delete
    Delete an object instance.

0x0A Multiple_Service_Packet
    Carry multiple embedded CIP requests.

0x0D Apply_Attributes
    Apply previously configured attributes.

0x0E Get_Attribute_Single
    Read one attribute.

0x10 Set_Attribute_Single
    Write one attribute.

0x11 Find_Next_Object_Instance

    Restore persistent values.

0x13 Save
    Save current values persistently.

    Perform no state-changing operation.

    Read one member of a composite attribute.

  Description: Protocol field 'commandspecificdatalength'. Layer: session. Role: length. Type: uint16. Inferred-from: wire. Binding-strength: serializer_order. Evidence-type: length_check.

  Implementation constraints: used as immediate length for payload serialization in GenerateEncapsulationHeader, must be even byte size of command specific data

  Description: Protocol field 'command'. Layer: session. Role: type. Inferred-from: protocol-template.
  Length: 16 bits

  Description: Protocol field 'sessionhandle'. Layer: session. Role: address. Type: uint32. Range: [0, 4294967295]. Inferred-from: wire. Binding-strength: direct_byte_parse. Evidence-type: offset.
  Length: 32 bits
  Implementation constraints: coded as CipSessionHandle which is typedef'd from CipUdint, must be 0 in ListServices command, is echoed back in responses

  Description: Protocol field 'encapsulationstatus'. Layer: session. Role: control. Type: uint32. Range: [0, 4294967295]. Inferred-from: wire. Binding-strength: serializer_order. Evidence-type: offset.
  Length: 32 bits
  Implementation constraints: 0 = success, non-zero = specific error code from EncapsulationProtocolErrorCode enum
